problem: Aiden strategy runtime receipts were being displayed as English machine logs instead of owner-readable Chinese strategic discussion.
implemented: Added detection for strategy runtime receipt output.
Added a Chinese owner-readable renderer for E114/E108-style strategy receipts.
Preserved the raw runtime receipt inside the runtime artifact while replacing the visible reply with a Chinese explanation.
Added CSS wrapping for long route ids, runtime labels, and CIEU tuple code.
Added regression tests for strategy receipt rendering and long-token wrapping.
owner_visible_change: The owner sees what the strategy receipt means in Chinese instead of a raw English runtime log.
limitations: This is deterministic receipt rendering, not a new strategic reasoning run.
The raw receipt remains available in runtime artifacts for audit/debug.
